defs.def: people in general, living together in communities 社会（以群体形式生活在一起的人的总称）

ex.s: Do we really recognise what it costs us as a society when children can’t move safely around our communities?
ex.t: 当孩子无法在我们的社区安全出行时，我们作为社会究竟意识到这让我们付出了什么代价吗？

ex.s: Societies all over the world view the concept of an adult as self-supporting and self-directed, because it identifies a point in the life cycle.
ex.t: 全世界的社会的都把“成年人”这一概念视为能够自立和自主，因为它标示了生命周期中的一个节点。

ex.s: The rules that assign meaning lie not just inside our heads, but also outside, in society, in social memory, social conventions and social relations.
ex.t: 赋予意义的规则不仅存在于我们头脑内部，也存在于外部——在社会中，在社会记忆、社会惯例和社会关系中。

ex.s: In recent years, researchers from diverse fields have agreed that short-termism is now a significant problem in industrialised societies.
ex.t: 近年来，来自不同领域的研究者一致认为，短视主义如今在工业化社会是一个重要问题。

ex.s: More than 30 years ago, the scholar Charles Hockett noted that speech sounds called labiodentals, such as “f” and “v”, were more common in the languages of societies that ate softer foods.
ex.t: 30多年前，学者查尔斯·霍克特(Charles Hockett)指出，在食用软食的社会语言中，称为labiodentals的语音，如“f”和“v”更为常见。

ex.s: Society pushes us to specialize, to become experts.
ex.t: 社会推动我们去专业化成为专家。

ex.s: know more about the society
ex.t: 多了解这个社会

ex.s: This is a quick look at life in Uzbekistan, made of friendliness and warmth, but also its darker side of society.
ex.t: 这是对乌兹别克斯坦生活的一瞥，由友好与温暖构成，但也有其社会中较阴暗的一面。

ex.s: In our society, we know that Earth has only one moon.
ex.t: 在我们的社会中，我们知道地球只有一颗卫星。

ex.s: Why did the author create the Shy and Mighty Society? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 为什么作者创造了害羞和强大的社会？ （不超过10个字）

ex.s: In 1928 Herbert Hoover imagined an America with “a chicken in every pot and a car in every garage.” Since then, this society has moved onward, never looking back, as the car transformed America from a farm-based society into an industrial power.zxx.k
ex.t: 1928年，赫伯特·胡佛设想了一个“每个锅里一只鸡、每个车库一辆车”的美国。从那以后，这个社会一往无前，从不回头，因为汽车把美国从一个以农业为基础的社会变成了一个工业强国。

ex.s: A farm-based society.
ex.t: 一个以农业为基础的社会。

ex.s: Others say it’s only natural that newcomers learn the language of their host nation, seeing it as a condition to ensure they can contribute to society.
ex.t: 另一些人说，新来者学习所在国的语言是再自然不过的事，他们把这看作是为了确保自己能为社会做贡献的一个条件。

ex.s: From childhood on my heart and soul have been full of kindness, but for six years now, I have been forced to remove myself from society, to live life alone.
ex.t: 从童年开始，我的内心和灵魂就充满了善意，但六年来，我被迫脱离社会，独自生活。

ex.s: Turning 18 also changed the way that society viewed me.
ex.t: 18岁也改变了社会对我的看法。

ex.s: The policy has had a great influence on Chinese society.
ex.t: 这项政策对中国社会产生了巨大的影响。

ex.s: The governments argue that this will help foreigners better join the society and promote understanding across cultures.
ex.t: 政府辩称，这将帮助外国人更好地融入社会，并促进跨文化的理解。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。

ex.s: Then I created the Shy and Mighty Society, a space for shy people like me to shine, and in the process of helping others, I could also push myself forward, bit by bit.
ex.t: 于是我创建了“羞怯而强大协会”，一个让像我一样害羞的人发光的地方；在帮助别人的过程中，我也能一点点推动自己前进。

ex.s: Suppose you are in charge of the Shy and Mighty Society, what will you do to help other shy people?
ex.t: 假设你是“害羞者与强者协会”的负责人，你会做什么来帮助其他害羞的人？

ex.s: It prevents people who are cut off from society falling victim to cheaters.
ex.t: 这项努力不仅是一种社区意识的表现——它也是一项预防措施。

defs.def: a particular community of people who share the same customs, laws, etc. 社会（共同遵守一定的习俗、法律等的特定群体）
a group of people who join together for a particular purpose 尤用于名称
the group of people in a country who are fashionable, rich and powerful 上流社会

ex.s: And yet every member of New York’s wealthy high society wanted nothing more than to pose for this man.
ex.t: 然而纽约富裕的上流社会的每一个成员最想做的就是为这个人摆姿势拍照。

ex.s: Through his fascination with what people were wearing, and not who they were, he opened the doors of fashion to everyone — fashion as he saw it belonged to the people, not just to high society and big brands.
ex.t: 透过他对人们穿着什么——而非他们是谁——的迷恋，他向所有人敞开了时尚的大门——他认为时尚属于大众，而不仅仅是上流社会和大品牌。

ex.s: Their stay in Elkhead is the subject of Nothing Daunted: The Unexpected Education of Two Society Girls in the West by Dorothy Wickenden, who is a magazine editor and Dorothy Woodruff’s granddaughter.
ex.t: 她们在埃尔克黑德的经历是多萝西·威肯登所著《毫不畏惧：两位上流社会女孩在西部的意外教育》一书的主题，威肯登是一位杂志编辑，也是多萝西·伍德拉夫的外孙女。

defs.def: the state of being with other people 相伴；交往
